image_description: A grand, ornate Baroque-style pipe organ installed in a church gallery. The instrument features a symmetrical facade with multiple towers of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, creating a stepped silhouette. The case is elaborately carved wood with gold leaf accents and green/red painted details. A large arched window is visible behind the central section of the organ. The surrounding architecture includes white stucco work and vaulted ceilings.
